_about: The 10/21 live test's error set (HD-Live-Test-Error-Set-v1.pdf): 19 bugs, 16 wording items, 5 AI-writing patterns. For each, the check that guards it and the words a finding must contain to count as that item. machine=false means the rig cannot see it, and `human` says why.

items.text: Blank form: "One thing left: the day you were born." (3 things missing)
"CHANNELS: None" on the summary (the chart has channels)
Unknown time: the three-lines box states Type/Authority/Profile with no "provisional"
Stripe: "Next: your birth date, time and place" on upgrades that promise nothing to type
Chart upgrade confirm button: "These are right — make my reading"
PDF pages left almost empty (one line; last page only the coaching card)
items.human: Shop PDFs: caught. The PHONE app's PDF is drawn on the phone, outside this rig (its own tests).

items.text: "Email me my charts" takes ~20 s for an inbox with many charts
"Email me my charts": older purchases all read "Your reading · The reading"; one chart listed twice
"Because your not-sf feeling is frustration" got past the checker
items.human: Shop checker: caught by the probe. The PHONE checker (Kotlin) is outside this rig; port the probe's cases to its parity tests.

items.text: /readings: "the summary keeps none of them"
/readings still says "Signature / Not-Self Theme"
Privacy: phone number "collected at payment"; "Stripe receives your phone"
Sample PDFs: old title "Jeremy Champagne" + "Timezone: UTC-05:00" line
Side note "CENTER: Single" (the definition, not the center)
items.human: Shop: caught. The phone's PDF margin is outside this rig.

items.text: Fresh-link email is the plain "is ready" email
Someone-new page cards: "your centers, your incarnation cross"
Website footers "v2.2 · Aug 2026"; privacy "Last updated 20 October"
items.human: Footer date: caught. The privacy page's "Last updated 20 October" matches its last commit (10/20); that it went live on the 21st is a push date the rig cannot see.

Phone place list offers "Anchorage (America)"
items.human: Phone app screen (its place list is built on the phone). The rig drives the web shop; the shop's own place list is checked by every journey's town pick.

Drawing says "EGO", tables say "Heart"
"Left Angle Cross of The Alpha" — capital "The"
Maya's "Your correction" note disappears once the chart becomes a reading
Phone chart tab "Profile 4/6" without "Opportunist / Role Model"
items.human: Phone app screen, outside this rig. (The shop's own pages are checked: every PROFILE value is read.)

items.text: Try-this lines are soft ("Notice how…", "Watch what happens…")
Each section's takeaway sentence printed twice (Start here + the section's opening line)
Glance rows as fragments ("Carrying a design that guides…")
Word slips ("people you happen to inhabit", "body graph", gate numbers spelled out…)
items.human: Only the slips already named are searched for. A NEW slip (an odd word, a wrong register) needs a human read: the list of lines not found in the source is what to read.

items.text: Checker gaps: banned words matched exactly, so "not-sf" and "frustrated" pass
